_what: Input for set-label-settings.cjs, the 68% step of apply-update.ps1.

_modes.seed: DEFAULT. Make sure the LabelSettings row exists (schema defaults if it was missing) and print what is configured. Existing values are never changed.
_modes.force: Write exactly the numbers in "values" over whatever is there. Only use this when you have decided the shop's label geometry on purpose - it is one singleton row shared by product labels (TSC, 105 mm roll, 2 x 51x32) and shelf labels (roll width chosen in the panel).

_rolls.product_labels: TSC TTP-244 Pro: mediaWidthMm 105, widthMm 51, heightMm 32 -> 2 labels per row (6 labels per A4 sheet path is unrelated).
_rolls.shelf_labels: Measured roll: mediaWidthMm 104 with widthMm 34, heightMm 25 -> 3 labels per row, 36 rows for 108 labels. widthMm must stay <= 34, because the column count is floor(mediaWidthMm / widthMm) and 35 gives 2.
